# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** Six to seven years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c38 P9](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** School student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair child with long, sleek hazel curls that never get out of order. She has mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and a neat, prim mouth.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)_

## Personality

Dora is prim, quiet, polite, and well-behaved, behaving like a little lady at the table. Unlike her twin brother Davy, she is timid and prone to fear, such as being scared of the dark or ghost stories.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c10 P14](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0014), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007)_

## Traits

- Prim and polite  <sub>[v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002)</sub>

## Goals

- Marry Paul Irving in the future  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## History

Following the illness and death of her mother, Mary Keith, Dora and her twin brother Davy were brought to Green Gables to live under the care of Marilla Cuthbert and Anne Shirley. Upon arriving, she behaved demurely, though Davy frequently took advantage of her mild demeanor by taking her food. When school opened, she began attending class alongside her brother, temporarily sitting with Mirabel Cotton. Mirabel's unsettling tales about a deceased uncle ghost frightened Dora so deeply that she became terrified of going upstairs in the dark until Anne comforted her.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P17](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0017), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 c21 P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Mary Keith and twin sister of Davy Keith
- Orphaned when her mother died, leading to her being taken in at Green Gables
